# Regenerated by tools/release_plugin.sh --update-manifest after a release is

# tools/get_plugin.sh and cmake/GetPjrtPlugin.cmake.

# linux-x86_64 is published for this JAX version. linux-aarch64 is not: on
# that platform `make plugin` prints the remedies and `make plugin-source`
# builds from the fork. Either producer may add the missing architecture to
# the same tag later. See docs/developer/release-process.md.
